# HYRR

> HYRR is a premium, AI-assisted hiring and recruitment management platform
> built for modern HR teams, recruiters, and talent acquisition professionals.

HYRR provides a unified workspace to manage the full recruitment lifecycle —
from posting job vacancies through to extending offers — with a focus on
beautiful design, fast workflows, and actionable data.

---

## What HYRR Does

HYRR is an Applicant Tracking System (ATS) with the following core modules:

- **Dashboard**: Real-time recruitment KPIs including total candidates, active
  openings, interviews booked, and offers sent. Pipeline distribution charts.

- **Jobs (Open Roles)**: Create and manage job vacancies. Each role shows
  location, type (Full-time / Part-time / Contract / Remote), posting date,
  status (Active / Closed), and the number of candidates in the pipeline.

- **Candidates Directory**: Searchable, filterable table of all applicants
  across all jobs. Supports bookmarking, direct messaging, and deletion.

- **Pipeline (Applications / Kanban Board)**: A drag-and-drop Kanban board
  with columns: Saved → Applied → In Process → Offer → Archived.
  Candidates are moved between stages by drag or by context menu.
  Each job has its own pipeline view.

- **Calendar**: Monthly interview calendar. Hiring managers can view and book
  interview slots for specific days. Shows candidate name, interview type,
  and time for each event.

- **Messages**: Inbox-style direct messaging between recruiters and candidates.
  Supports conversation threads, read receipts, and message history.

- **Analytics**: Data visualisation of the recruitment funnel. Charts include
  monthly application intake (area chart) and pipeline distribution (bar chart).
  KPIs: application growth rate, offer conversion rate, average days to hire.

---

## Target Users

- Recruiters and talent acquisition specialists
- HR managers and directors
- Founders and startup hiring leads
- Staffing agencies managing multiple clients
- Enterprise HR departments

---

## Key Differentiators

1. **Premium Apple-inspired UI** — pixel-perfect, 8px grid, smooth Framer Motion animations
2. **Kanban-first pipeline** — intuitive drag-and-drop with @dnd-kit
3. **Unified workspace** — jobs, candidates, calendar, messages, and analytics in one place
4. **AI-assisted screening** (Pro) — intelligent candidate ranking and matching
5. **Real-time notifications** — instant updates when candidates change pipeline stages

---

## Technology

- Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4
- Animations: Framer Motion
- State: Zustand
- Drag & Drop: @dnd-kit/core
- Charts: Recharts
- Icons: Lucide React

---

## Pricing

- **Free tier**: Up to 3 active jobs, unlimited candidates, core pipeline features
- **Pro**: Unlimited jobs, advanced analytics, AI screening, priority support
- **Enterprise**: Custom pricing, SSO, API access, dedicated CSM

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is HYRR?**
HYRR is an all-in-one recruitment management platform that replaces spreadsheets,
generic email chains, and disconnected ATS tools with a single premium workspace.

**Who is HYRR for?**
Primarily for recruiters, HR teams, and hiring managers at companies of all sizes —
from 5-person startups to enterprise HR departments.

**Does HYRR have a Kanban board?**
Yes. The Pipeline view in HYRR is a fully interactive drag-and-drop Kanban board.
Each job vacancy has its own board with columns: Saved, Applied, In Process, Offer,
and Archived.

**What analytics does HYRR provide?**
Application growth rate, offer conversion rate, average time-to-hire, monthly intake
trends (area chart), and pipeline distribution by stage (bar chart).

**Is HYRR free?**
HYRR has a free tier supporting up to 3 active jobs. Pro plans unlock unlimited roles
and AI-assisted features.
